instrument: Total group revenue (membership + working-group fees + EU research grants + services)
note: Combined group revenue as stated in the Eclipse annual community report (latest restatement; 2024 first reported as 12.8M EUR, restated 13.5M). Not split by source: includes EU-funded research projects (Research@Eclipse, 16 active in 2025) which are PUBLIC money, so summable=false for the private total. Corporate membership + working-group fees are the bulk (INFERENCE). Strategic members (15 in 2026) include non-European IBM, Oracle, Microsoft (US), Huawei (CN), Google (US, from Apr 2026) alongside SAP, Bosch and other EU firms. Pre-2022 figures in USD (2020 actual, 2021 combined revenue 7.6M USD per 2022 report).
